artworks.title: Sir Edward Coke
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man's portrait. The man is depicted from the upper three-quarters of his body, facing slightly to the right with a composed expression. He has distinct features including a high forehead, facial hair on the sides of his cheeks, a pointed beard, and a thin mustache. His hair is short and receding, revealing a bald hairline. He wears a detailed garment with an elaborate ruffled collar, rich patterns on the sleeves, and an ornate button at the chest. The portrait is set inside an oval frame with "PATIENS" and "PRVDENS" on the sides and "Anno 1629" at the top. The background within the oval frame is intricately engraved lines. The print is on an off-white background.

artworks.title: Sir Edward Coke
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man from 1670. The man is depicted in an upper body view and is facing slightly to his right with a direct gaze. He has a high forehead, a long, narrow nose, and a small pointed beard. The man's hair is neatly styled and appears to be receding at the temples. He is wearing a ruff collar, an embroidered coat, and a garment with buttons or jewels. The background features an oval frame with the words "PATIENTIA" and "PRUDENS" inscribed along the border and "Anno 1670" at the top. Below the portrait, there is text and a coat of arms.

artworks.title: Queen Elizabeth
artworks.artist: John Payne and Willem de Passe
artworks.description: The image features a portrait of Queen Elizabeth I from the Elizabethan era. The portrait shows the queen in an elaborate dress with a large ruff around her neck, detailed fabric patterns, fine facial features, styled hair with a crown and pearls, holding a scepter. Figures in period clothing, holding banners with text, are positioned around her. The background has ornamental scrollwork, and figures at the bottom are kneeling and standing next to an open drum, engaged in carrying pikes. Text at the bottom of the portrait is a poetic tribute to Elizabeth I.

artworks.title: Queen Elizabeth
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a woman within an oval frame. She has an elongated face with smooth features, prominent eyes, and a calm expression. The woman's hair is styled upward and adorned with a crown embellished with jewels and pearls. She wears an ornate gown with a high lace collar, richly detailed patterns covering the fabric. She holds a scepter in her right hand, while her left hand is on an orb. The attire includes multiple pieces of jewelry. The background has a textured shading, framing the portrait. The oval frame's border includes inscribed Latin words.

artworks.title: Joseph Hall, Bishop of Exeter and Norwich
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an older man facing slightly to one side, with a long face, deep-set eyes, pronounced eyebrows, a sharp nose, and a long white beard. He wears a dark cap, a high-collared ruff, and holds an open book in one hand. A medallion hangs around his neck. The background features decorative scrolls with text, and the portrait is framed with an inscription identifying him as "EXON EPISCOP. VERA EFFIGIES IOSEPHI HALL REV. PATER." Verses below elaborate on his virtues, and the image has an intricate illustrative style, indicating it may be an engraving or woodcut from an earlier period.

artworks.title: Francis Hawkins, Jesuit
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing a portrait of a boy from the chest up. He is positioned facing forward with his head turned slightly to his right. The boy's facial features include a smooth complexion, a youthful face, and a serene expression with nearly symmetrical eyes looking directly at the viewer. His hair is shoulder-length and wavy, with a straight fringe across his forehead. He is dressed in an elaborate outfit typical of the period, featuring a finely detailed lace collar and a doublet adorned with decorative elements like a ribbon bow and a series of buttons down the center. He is part of an elaborate wooden or stone decorative frame that features intricate scrollwork and stylized elements. The text within the frame reads "François Hawkins tirant a l’age d’huit ans," indicating the identity and age of the boy. The background consists of a patterned surface.

artworks.title: Francis Hawkins
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a young boy named François Hawkins. The boy is facing slightly left with his eyes looking ahead. He has distinct facial features with wide eyes, a small mouth, and a slightly rounded face. His hair is medium-length, wavy, and parted in the middle. He wears a dark garment with a large white collar visible beneath. The background consists of an oval frame with text identifying him and his age in French and English. Below the portrait, there is a poetic inscription.

artworks.title: Henry VII
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a male figure visible from the waist up. The person is positioned facing forward with their right hand resting on the table and the left hand holding an orb. His facial features include a long, narrow face with pronounced cheekbones and deep-set eyes, and his hair, which is shoulder-length, appears to be quite fine and is framed by a hat. He is wearing a richly adorned robe with a fur collar, ornate chains, and a mantle decorated with jeweled patterns. His hat is adorned with a brooch featuring a cross design. The background is a simple etched texture with two heraldic crests - one to the upper left and another to the upper right. The one on the left displays a coat of arms, while the one on the right features a crowned rose emblem. Below the figure, there is a decorative inscription that reads "Cor Regis inscrutabile" and "John Payne Sculpsit" at the bottom edge of the engraving.

artworks.title: Rev. Arthur Hildersam
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated formally with one hand raised and the other resting on an open book. The man faces slightly to his left and has a pointed nose, attentive eyes, short beard and mustache, and closely cropped hair. He wears a ruff around his neck and a dark garment with puffed sleeves. The background is ornate with textured details, and a coat of arms is depicted on the paneled wall nearby. The setting suggests a formal or academic environment.

artworks.title: Arthur Lake, Bishop of Bath and Wells
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait engraving of a man from the waist up. He is seated and facing slightly to the right, with a forward gaze. His facial features include a sharp nose, high cheekbones, and a pointed grey beard and mustache. He wears a skullcap over closely cropped hair, a dark robe with a white ruff around the neck, and layered sleeves with visible folds. The man holds a small book in his right hand and rests his left arm along the edge of the oval frame. The border features cherubic figures at the top corners with shields, fruit and foliage motifs on the sides, and inscriptions around the oval and at the bottom, all within a detailed border.

artworks.title: Nicholas Leate, London Merchant
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a man facing slightly to the right. He is holding an object with his hands together in front of him. The man has a full beard and mustache, styled hair under a cap, and wears an embroidered coat with a fur collar and intricate patterns on the sleeves. There is an elaborate frame with scrollwork, text, a shield with a crest at the top, and military symbols on the sides. A decorative cartouche with a poetic inscription is at the bottom, with a textured hatch pattern in the background.

artworks.title: James Ley, First Earl of Marlborough
artworks.description: The image shows a man with defined facial features, wearing a cap and an elaborate ruffled collar. He has a mustache and a chin beard, and his attire suggests a person of high rank or importance. The background is a textured pattern. At the bottom, a caption identifies him as "The Honourable Sr. James Ley," along with his titles and position.

artworks.title: James Ley, First Earl of Marlborough
artworks.artist: John Payne and Willem de Passe
artworks.description: The image features a portrait of a man from the shoulders up in a rectangular frame. The man faces slightly to his right with deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a trimmed beard. He wears a fabric cap and an elaborate lace ruff collar. Surrounding him are smaller figures of ornately dressed men with large feathered hats, some on horseback engaging in activities like hunting or jousting. The background includes images of horses, dogs, and action scenes. Inscriptions with titles and names are present at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Algernon Percy, Earl of Northampton
artworks.artist: John Payne after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the upper portion of his body. He is facing forward with a slightly turned head. The man has an elongated face, a prominent nose, a small mustache, and long wavy hair that flows past his shoulders. His attire is elaborate with a high collar or ruffled garment visible. The background features stylized clouds, adding depth to the scene. The engraved text identifies the subject as Algernon Percy, Earle of Northumberland, and credits the artist and engravers.

artworks.title: Henry de Vere, Eighteenth Earl of Oxford
artworks.description: This is an engraving of a man shown from the waist up in a three-quarter view. He is turned slightly to his left, looking at the viewer with a slight smile. The man has a pointed nose, sharp chin, well-groomed mustache, curly hair flowing from under a wide-brimmed hat with a feather, and ornate clothing typical of the Renaissance or Baroque periods. He wears a doublet with intricate details, a sash, puffed sleeves, and a prominent ruffled collar with lace layers. The man holds a cane over his shoulder in his right hand. The background consists of fine horizontal lines creating a textured appearance contrasting the detailed depiction of the man.

artworks.title: Sir Benjamin Rudyerd, Court of Wardes and Liveryes
artworks.artist: John Payne, after Daniel Mytens the Elder
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man in an oval frame. The man has a mature appearance with distinctive facial features including a prominent forehead, arched eyebrows, deep-set eyes, a mustache, and a goatee. His hair is styled in curls. He is dressed in 17th-century attire with an elaborate lace ruff collar. In the background, there is a textured pattern. The oval frame includes the text "Sr Beniamin Rvdyerd." Below the frame is a decorative plaque with an engraved inscription and ornamental motifs.

artworks.title: Sir Benjamin Rudyerd
artworks.artist: John Payne, after Daniel Mytens the Elder
artworks.description: This is an engraved portrait of Sir Benjamin Rudyer, showing his upper body and head. He is slightly turned to his right, facing the viewer. He has a beard, mustache, expressive eyes, furrowed brows, wavy medium-length hair, and is wearing a patterned garment with a large ruffled collar. He does not appear to be wearing any visible jewelry nor holding any objects. The background features a textured pattern within an oval frame with inscriptions and a poem at the bottom in a decorative frame.

artworks.title: Sir Benjamin Rudyerd
artworks.artist: John Payne, after Daniel Mytens the Elder
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a man's bust-length portrait. He has a moustache, beard, and wavy hair. He wears a patterned garment with a lace ruff around his neck. The engraving includes the text "Sr. Benjamin Rudyer" and the date "Anno D[o] 1652" within an oval frame. The background within the frame is detailed. Below the oval frame, there is a decorative plaque with scrollwork and a verse in artistic script.

artworks.title: Rev. Richard Sibbes
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with detailed features. He faces slightly to his left with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has a rounded face with delicate features, a prominent forehead, a straight nose, and a modest smile. He appears mature with wrinkles, facial hair in the form of a short beard and mustache, and short wavy hair. He wears a unique headdress combining elements of a cap and a crown, along with formal attire including a large ruffled collar and a dark textured robe or gown. Surrounding him is an oval frame with inscriptions, giving a scholarly aura. The background has a finely hatched texture.

artworks.title: Sir William Wadd
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an older man depicted from the waist up. He is positioned facing towards the viewer's left. The man has a long beard and mustache, with detailed facial features that include deep-set eyes and a furrowed brow. His hair is mostly covered by a cap. He is wearing a large ruffled collar and an ornate coat with fur trimming covering his shoulders, fastened with ornate buttons down the front. There is no visible jewelry. In the upper right corner of the portrait, there is a heraldic emblem showcasing detailed coats of arms. The background of the image appears textured and plain.

artworks.title: William Whitaker, Master of Saint John's College, Cambridge
artworks.description: The image displays an upper-body portrait of a man seated facing slightly to his right, holding an open book in his right hand. The man has a solemn expression, characterized by a furrowed brow and mustache, and his hair is medium-length, neatly trimmed under a broad-brimmed flat cap. He is dressed in a scholarly robe with a high, ruffled collar and loose sleeves. The portrait is within an oval frame adorned with decorative foliage patterns and Latin text. The engraving features detailed line work emphasizing textures and shading. The background consists of a lined pattern, adding depth to the composition. A caption at the bottom of the image contains a description of the subject's academic affiliations and accomplishments.

artworks.title: George Wither, Poet
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man from the chest up, positioned facing slightly to the right while maintaining eye contact with the viewer. He has a short mustache and a beard, with wavy hair under a broad-brimmed hat. He wears an ornate garment with a large, lace-trimmed collar featuring floral patterns. The attire and coat of arms suggest significance. There is no visible jewelry or objects. The background has an oval border with text and a poetic inscription underneath.

artworks.title: George Wither, Poet
artworks.description: This image depicts a man from the waist up, facing the viewer and slightly angled to his right. He wears a broad-brimmed hat, a dark garment with a large lace collar that flows over his shoulders. The intricate collar contrasts with the darker fabric underneath. The man has a mustache, a small goatee, and curly hair visible under his hat. To the left of his shoulder, there is a shield-like emblem with a coat of arms. The background is a textured gray surface inside an oval border with inscriptions. Below the portrait, an engraved inscription contains contemplative poetry.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a man, seated in a slightly turned position facing the viewer. He has a prominent nose, well-defined cheekbones, and curly hair that extends to his ears. His facial expression appears calm and focused. The man wears a traditional outfit with a large, ornate ruffled collar and an intricately designed jacket featuring a detailed pattern and small buttons down the front. In his left hand, he holds a long, slender object, while his right hand rests on a round glass object on the table before him. In the background, behind the man, there is a textured drapery. The image is rendered in fine detail with a stippled effect. At the bottom of the image, there is a Latin inscription.
